svg.title: Fire inspector — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as fire inspector, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A fire extinguisher with hose is checked against a separate inspection card. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face and round glasses.
